headline: China opens investigations into U.S. trade practices in response to Trump tariff moves
summary: China launched two investigations into U.S. trade practices on Friday, signalling it will push back against U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs ahead of his May visit.
why: U.S.-China trade tensions affect global supply chains, tariffs and corporate earnings across many sectors. The world's two largest economies are central to international trade flows.
why_moved: Beijing's probes are a retaliatory response to new U.S. tariffs, raising the risk of an escalating trade dispute between the two largest economies.
